data.one_liner: A Flutter widget for smooth counting up or down with animation and formatting options.
data.what_it_does: Provides a SmoothCounter widget and controller to smoothly animate number changes (integers or doubles) using custom durations, curves, and number formatting. It supports prefix and suffix texts as well as initial animation settings.
use_when: You need to animate numeric values changing over time like a counter or financial amount.
You want custom number formatting using patterns or the intl package.
avoid_when: You just need a static text display without any count-up or count-down animation.
Your project uses an older version of Flutter or Dart below the required thresholds.
strengths: Supports both int and double values
Easy to customize with number formats, prefixes, and suffixes
Provides a controller option for advanced animation control like curve and duration
weaknesses: Requires Dart 3.8.0+ and Flutter 3.32.0+, which are quite recent requirements
